defsZh: a. 包含的, 包括的
defsEn: including much or everything; and especially including stated limits

defsZh:
a. 不夠的, 不能勝任的, 不充足的
[法] 不足的, 不充分的, 不能勝任的

examples.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.
Don't read under insufficient light, for it is bad for your eyes.
examples.zh: 不要在太暗的光線下看書，那對你的眼睛不好的。

defsEn: of a quantity not able to fulfill a need or requirement

defsZh: a. 介紹的, 引導的, 開端的

examples.en: I have to take an introductory seminar next year.
Write this in the introductory section of your paper.

defsEn: serving to open or begin

defsZh:
n. 垃圾, 烏七八糟的東西, 舢板
[計] 清除

examples.en: Tom has accumulated a lot of junk.
Tom used to eat a lot of junk food.
examples.zh: 湯姆以前經常吃很多垃圾食品。

defsEn: the remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up

defsZh: n. 夫人, 女王, 公主
defsEn: a woman of refinement

defsZh:
n. 英里數
[經] 運費(按英里計算的)

examples.en: This car has good gas mileage.

defsEn: distance measured in miles

defsZh:
a. 嘈雜的, 喧鬧的
[機] 噪聲的, 嘈雜的
defsEn: full of or characterized by loud and nonmusical sounds

defsZh:
n. 平鍋, 淺盤, 盆地, 硬土層, 拍攝全景
v. 上下左右移動, 搖鏡頭, 淘洗, 淘金

examples.en: Take the pan off the fire.

defsEn: cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel

defsZh:
n. 包裹, 部分, 片
vt. 分配, 打包
a. 部分的
adv. 區域性地

examples.en: Did you get the parcel I sent you?
examples.zh: 你收到我寄給你的包裹了嗎？

examples.en: She tied up the parcel with string.
examples.zh: 她用繩子把包裹緊緊綁好了。

defsEn: a wrapped container

defsZh:
n. 義大利麵食
[醫] 糊劑, 泥膏劑

examples.en: Lunch is often rice or pasta.
Kids love pasta in tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 茄汁意粉是小朋友的最愛。

defsEn: a dish that contains pasta as its main ingredient

defsZh:
n. 期刊
a. 定期出版的, (有關)期刊的, 間歇(性的), 週期的, 定期的

examples.en: The periodical costs less than the book.

defsEn: a publication that appears at fixed intervals

defsZh:
n. 藥丸, 彈丸, 屈辱, 胡說
v. 做成藥丸, 形成丸狀, 服藥丸, 挫敗, 搶劫

examples.en: These pills act on the heart.
examples.zh: 這種藥片對心臟有療效。

examples.en: Why does Tom take those pills?
examples.zh: 為啥湯姆要吃這些藥片？

examples.en: Before going to bed, I took three pills to stop a cold.
examples.zh: 睡覺前我吃了三片藥來治療感冒。

defsEn: something that resembles a tablet of medicine in shape or size

defsZh:
a. 可攜帶的, 可搬運的, 可移動的
[計] 可移植的
defsEn: easily or conveniently transported

defsZh:
a. 準時的, 守時的, 點狀的, 中肯的
[經] 準時的, 不誤期的, 準時

examples.en: I expect you to be punctual.

defsEn: acting or arriving or performed exactly at the time appointed

defsZh:
n. 娛樂, 消遣, 休息, 再創造
[醫] 娛樂, 休養

examples.en: Playing go is my only recreation.
The resort has a recreation area.
Skiing is a good form of recreation.

defsEn: an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates

defsZh:
vt. 減輕, 救濟, 解除, 使免除, 換...的班, 使得到調劑, 使不單調, 襯托, 使顯著
vi. 救濟, 當替補投手, 呈鮮明突出

examples.zh: 我透過運動來緩解壓力。

defsEn: provide physical relief, as from pain

defsZh:
n. 提醒的人, 暗示
[經] 催單
defsEn: a message that helps you remember something

defsZh:
n. 謠言, 傳聞
vt. 謠傳
defsEn: gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth

defsZh:
n. 圍巾, 頭巾, 領帶, 領巾, 嵌接
vt. 用圍巾圍, 嵌接

examples.en: Where did Tom buy that scarf?
examples.zh: 湯姆在哪兒買的那個圍巾呀？

examples.en: Why are you wearing that scarf?
Don't you like my yellow scarf?
examples.zh: 你不喜歡我的黃圍巾嗎？

defsEn: a garment worn around the head or neck or shoulders for warmth or decoration

defsZh:
a. 海邊的, 海濱的
n. 海濱

examples.en: It never rains at the seaside.
He wants to go to the seaside.
I've been to the seaside by car.

defsEn: the shore of a sea or ocean regarded as a resort

defsZh:
vt. 弄短, 縮短, 減少
vi. 縮小, 變短

examples.en: I daub the venison with shortening.
examples.zh: 我把起酥油塗抹在鹿肉上。

examples.en: Don't smoke. Smoking can shorten your penis.
examples.zh: 別吸菸。吸菸可能縮短你的陰莖。

defsEn: make shorter than originally intended; reduce or retrench in length or duration

defsZh: adv. 特別地, 專門地

examples.en: This is a store that caters specially to students.
examples.zh: 這是一家專門為學生提供服務的商店。

examples.en: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
examples.zh: 會議將會在特意安排的禮堂裡舉行。

defsEn: in a special manner

defsZh:
n. 溢位, 濺出, 摔下, 溢位量, 木片, 小塞子
vt. 使溢位, 使散落, 灑, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下
vi. 溢位, 湧流, 摔下

examples.en: All of the milk was spilled.
examples.zh: 所有的牛奶都溢位去了。

defsEn: liquid that is spilled

defsZh: n. 配偶

examples.en: Tom found a wonderful spouse in Mary.
examples.zh: 湯姆認識了瑪莉這麼個好老婆。

defsEn: a person's partner in marriage

defsZh:
vt. 減去, 扣掉, 減少
vi. 做減法
[計] 減

examples.en: Subtract two from ten and you have eight.
Subtract three from eight and you get five.

defsEn: make a subtraction

defsZh:
n. 平板, 門牌, 筆記簿, 碑, 匾, 藥片
[化] 片劑

examples.en: The tablets took away my pain.
I can't swallow these tablets without a drink of water.
examples.zh: 不喝水我咽不下這些藥片。

examples.en: Take after meals, twice per day, two tablets each time.
examples.zh: 飯後服用，一日兩次，一次兩粒。

defsEn: a slab of stone or wood suitable for bearing an inscription

defsZh:
n. 噸
[經] 噸

examples.zh: 薩米收到了一大堆郵件。

examples.en: This grizzly bear weighs half a ton.

defsEn: a United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds

defsZh: v. 出售, 從事販賣

examples.zh: 咖啡自動販賣機是壞的。
這臺自動販賣機故障了。

examples.en: The vending machines are over there.

defsEn: sell or offer for sale from place to place

defsZh: n. 瑜珈

examples.en: There's a guy in my yoga class.
examples.zh: 有個小夥子在我的瑜伽班裡。

defsEn: Hindu discipline aimed at training the consciousness for a state of perfect spiritual insight and tranquility that is achieved through the three paths of actions and knowledge and devotion

defsZh:
n. 重音, 口音, 特點, 注重點
vt. 重讀, 加重音號於, 強調

examples.en: Do you speak with an accent?

defsEn: distinctive manner of oral expression

defsZh:
a. 顧問的, 諮詢的, 勸告的
[法] 勸告的, 忠告的, 諮詢的

examples.en: Tom has assumed an advisory role.
There's a flood advisory in effect.
There's a fog advisory this morning.

defsEn: giving advice; ,

defsZh:
a. 睡著的, 長眠的, 麻木的
adv. 熟睡地
defsEn: in a state of sleep

defsZh:
a. 可靠的, 可信的, 真正的
[法] 被認證的, 確認的, 可信的

examples.en: I really hope that I can speak authentic Chinese.
examples.zh: 我很希望可以說一口地道的中文。

examples.en: Are there authentic Chinese restaurants in France?

defsEn: conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief

defsZh: n. 麵包店

examples.en: The girl who works at the bakery is cute.
examples.zh: 在麵包房工作的姑娘很可愛。

examples.en: In U.S. bakeries, a "baker's dozen" is 13, not 12.
examples.zh: 在美國的麵包店，"麵包師傅的一打"是13，不是12。

defsEn: a workplace where baked goods (breads and cakes and pastries) are produced or sold

defsZh:
n. 硬紙盒, 紙板箱
[化] 卡紙

examples.en: Robert dropped an entire carton of milk all over Linda's head.
examples.zh: 羅伯將一整盒牛奶灑在琳達頭上。

examples.en: I need a carton of eggs.

defsEn: the quantity contained in a carton

defsZh:
n. 分隔間, 臥車包房, 防水艙隔
[醫] 隔室, 隔間

examples.en: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.
examples.zh: 我完全是在偶然的情況下發現了密室。

examples.en: We rode in the same compartment.

defsEn: a space into which an area is subdivided

defsZh:
a. 能共處的, 可並立的, 適合的
[計] 相容的; 相容的
defsEn: able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination

defsZh:
n. 消費, 消費量, 癆病
[化] 消耗量; 耗量

examples.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
examples.zh: 酒的消費每年都在上升。

examples.en: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
examples.zh: 限制白糖和鹽的攝取量。

examples.en: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
examples.zh: 東歐的酒精消耗量比西歐高。

defsEn: the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)

defsZh: a. 方便, 合宜

examples.zh: 我們的房子位於交通便利的地方。

examples.en: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
examples.zh: 這間酒店的交通位置很方便。

defsEn: in a convenient manner

defsZh:
n. 化妝品
a. 化妝用的

examples.en: There is nothing wrong with boys wearing cosmetics.
examples.zh: 男孩化粧沒有甚麼問題。

examples.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
examples.zh: 大部份的保險計劃不包含整容手術。

defsEn: a toiletry designed to beautify the body
